findings.text: Live dual-payload compat: librariesAccessible/itemTagsSelected accepted on req.body OR req.body.permissions with delete from req.body, commented 'Old model stored them outside of permissions' — documented, bounded legacy shim.
~35-line permission validation/mapping block duplicated between create and update with subtle drift risk.

Author-merge path (bookAuthorModel.removeByIds + bulkCreate + destroy + saveMetadataFile) has no transaction, unlike Collection/Playlist controllers which use Database.sequelize.transaction — mid-merge failure can leave inconsistent book-author links.
Inconsistent root guard: update() blocks non-root admins from touching root-user API keys, but delete() has no such check.
Legacy endpoints kept fully wired with @deprecated/TODO markers (e.g. GET /api/series/:id 'Update mobile app to use /api/libraries/:id/series/:seriesId'); documented legacy.
Mild bloat: 657-line /api/me grab-bag spanning 22 handlers (sessions, bookmarks, progress, password, e-reader devices, yearly stats); authz is correct throughout.
